critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/supplier_assessment/service.py create_questionnaire stores scoring_method from request without defaulting; with omitted field this becomes null and violates QuestionnaireResponse schema (string).
backend/server.py CORS fallback sets allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True, which is non-compliant for credentialed browser requests.
backend/modules/auth/router.py uses rate limit but has no per-account failed-attempt lockout state despite auth playbook requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created and auto-cleaned TEST questionnaire/question only in live test (cleanup fixture). No permanent seed data retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Focused unit test file passed (3/3). Live regression file shows single blocker: questionnaire POST without scoring_method => 500 ResponseValidationError. With scoring_method='question', questionnaire create/update and question exact-weight override checks pass. Rankings endpoint and suppliers endpoint both return 200 safely; supplier list includes canonical_score_snapshot field. Supplier account currently returns 404 on /my-assessment (known relationship fixture gap).
rca of the issue: Root cause: API contract mismatch between creation defaults and response model. QuestionnaireCreate allows scoring_method omitted, service persists scoring_method=None, but QuestionnaireResponse requires scoring_method as string. FastAPI response validation then throws 500 on create/list/get for rows containing null scoring_method. Repro: POST /api/supplier-assessment/questionnaires with only name + esg_section_weights + overall_supplier_weights (no scoring_method) => 500. Mitigation: default scoring_method to 'question' at service layer and/or schema; backfill existing null rows.
